nate (partnerships): Quick heads-up  Azure partner (Minji) wants Redwood listed in Korea Central (koreacentral) marketplace. They asked for entitlement doc, MPN ID, and initial capacity targets. Target go-live late-May. Can cloud + legal triage?

minji (azure-partner): Hi all  we can enable an offer in koreacentral. Need partner MPN, offer sku names, and whether you plan BYOK (customer-managed keys). Marketplace side also needs a test subscription for validation.

rachel (cloud-ops): What VM SKUs are you planning to expose? ND A100 v4 or NVv4? ND-series will be necessary for inference perf. Also need subscription IDs so we can request regional quota raise.

arun (eng-platform): For production LLM inference with our batching profile, ND96as_v4 (A100) is preferred. If customers want cheaper / fallback we can add NV12 for non-latency-critical workloads. Initial recommendation: reserve 3 ND nodes (12 A100-equivalent cards) to cover 100-150 req/s.

nate (partnerships): MPN: RWD-1427. Offer SKUs: `redwood.marketplace.dedicated_nd` and `redwood.marketplace.hosted_basic`. We'll do BYOK for customers that require it, but initial validation can use MS-managed keys.

tay (legal): I need to see the draft Marketplace Terms + a data flow diagram. Also confirm whether logs or telemetry sampled in region might cross borders. If BYOK is allowed, ensure key residency is specified.

minji (azure-partner): Understood. We'll accept MS-managed for validation. For production customers we can enable customer KMS (Key Vault) integration. Marketplace validation requires a test subscription with contributor access for 72h.

rachel (cloud-ops): Example Azure quota request we'll file (replace placeholders):
```
az support create --problem-classification "Quota for Virtual Machines" \
  --title "Increase NDv4 quota in koreacentral" \
  --description "Requesting increase to ND96as_v4 quota to 12 GPUs and vCPU to 192 for Redwood marketplace onboarding" \
  --subscription "REPLACE_WITH_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"
```

arun (eng-platform): Two perf notes: (1) ND-series has a different NUMA layout; our runtime needs kernel tuning for multi-card nodes, I'll prep a small checklist. (2) Coldstart of large models in koreacentral may be slower until caches warm; recommend we enable global fallback to northeastasia temporarily.

nate (partnerships): Timeline proposal: today - provide subscription + contact; Tue - marketplace test window; Wed - legal review; Thu - quota requests filed; aim for validation complete by next Fri. Any blockers?

minji (azure-partner): Works. I'll send the test subscription invite after we have the marketplace-admin email. Also need a short runbook for our validation engineers (how to exercise endpoints).

tay (legal): Please add data residency clause stating logs & telemetry are stored in koreacentral unless customer opts out. I'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum and post here for review.

rachel (cloud-ops): Send subscription and billing account to infra-team@redwood.ai. I'll open the quota ticket once received. Also need a contact for Key Vault owner if customers will use BYOK.

arun (eng-platform): I'll attach the kernel/perf checklist to the runbook. Also flagging that quantization profiles may change memory needs; if we move customers to 8-bit we can squeeze more QPS per node.

nate (partnerships): Action items summarized: (1) Redwood -> marketplace-admin email + subscription to Minji, (2) Rachel -> file quota ticket after subscription, (3) Arun -> perf checklist + runbook bits, (4) Tay -> legal addendum. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Azure validation team Wednesday 08:30 PT.

minji (azure-partner): Invite received. I'll include the marketplace validation lead. Looking forward to testing. :rocket:

rachel (cloud-ops): Noted. I'll post the support ticket number here once submitted.

nate (partnerships): Thanks team. Let's keep comms in this thread for audit. I'll update the partnership tracker with the timeline. :white_check_mark:
